mapper.select: SELECT sgm.id AS skill_group_member_id, sg.id AS skill_group_id, sg.group_name AS skill_group_name, u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.real_name, sgm.status AS member_status, sgm.max_active_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'ASSIGNED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assigned_ticket_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing_ticket_count, COUNT(t.id) AS active_ticket_count, COALESCE(ROUND(COUNT(t.id) / NULLIF(sgm.max_active_tickets, 0), 4), 0) AS workload_rate, CASE WHEN sg.status = 1 AND sgm.status = 1 AND u.status = 1 AND COUNT(t.id) < sgm.max_active_tickets THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS available_for_assign FROM skill_group_member sgm JOIN skill_group sg ON sg.id = sgm.skill_group_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = sgm.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.assignee_id = u.id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'PROCESSING') WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.role_code = 'AGENT' AND r.status = 1 ) GROUP BY sgm.id, sg.id, sg.group_name, sg.status, u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.status, sgm.status, sgm.max_active_tickets ORDER BY available_for_assign DESC, workload_rate ASC, sgm.id ASC

SELECT stat_date, SUM(created_ticket_count) AS created_ticket_count, SUM(resolved_ticket_count) AS resolved_ticket_count, SUM(closed_ticket_count) AS closed_ticket_count FROM ( SELECT DATE(t.created_at) AS stat_date, COUNT(1) AS created_ticket_count, 0 AS resolved_ticket_count, 0 AS closed_ticket_count FROM ticket t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.created_at >= #{startTime} AND t.created_at < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(t.created_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(l.created_at) AS stat_date, 0 AS created_ticket_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.ticket_id) AS resolved_ticket_count, 0 AS closed_ticket_count FROM ticket_operation_log l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.operation_type = 'RESOLVE' AND l.created_at >= #{startTime} AND l.created_at < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(l.created_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(l.created_at) AS stat_date, 0 AS created_ticket_count, 0 AS resolved_ticket_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.ticket_id) AS closed_ticket_count FROM ticket_operation_log l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.operation_type = 'CLOSE' AND l.created_at >= #{startTime} AND l.created_at < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(l.created_at) ) trend GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.first_response_deadline IS NOT NULL AND (t.first_responded_at IS NOT NULL OR t.first_response_deadline < #{now}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS first_response_evaluated_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.first_response_deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.first_responded_at IS NOT NULL AND t.first_responded_at <= t.first_response_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS first_response_met_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.first_response_deadline IS NOT NULL AND ((t.first_responded_at IS NOT NULL AND t.first_responded_at > t.first_response_deadline) OR (t.first_responded_at IS NULL AND t.first_response_deadline < #{now})) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS first_response_breached_count, COALESCE(ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN t.first_response_deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.first_responded_at IS NOT NULL AND t.first_responded_at <= t.first_response_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.first_response_deadline IS NOT NULL AND (t.first_responded_at IS NOT NULL OR t.first_response_deadline < #{now}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4), 0) AS first_response_compliance_rate,
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.resolve_deadline IS NOT NULL AND (resolved.resolved_at IS NOT NULL OR t.resolve_deadline < #{now}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS resolve_evaluated_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.resolve_deadline IS NOT NULL AND resolved.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved.resolved_at <= t.resolve_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS resolve_met_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.resolve_deadline IS NOT NULL AND ((resolved.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved.resolved_at > t.resolve_deadline) OR (resolved.resolved_at IS NULL AND t.resolve_deadline < #{now})) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS resolve_breached_count, COALESCE(ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN t.resolve_deadline IS NOT NULL AND resolved.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved.resolved_at <= t.resolve_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.resolve_deadline IS NOT NULL AND (resolved.resolved_at IS NOT NULL OR t.resolve_deadline < #{now}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 4), 0) AS resolve_compliance_rate FROM ticket t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ticket_id, MIN(created_at) AS resolved_at FROM ticket_operation_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND operation_type = 'RESOLVE' GROUP BY ticket_id ) resolved ON resolved.ticket_id = t.id WHERE t.deleted = 0
